name: Gokkun Mama o Kyouiku Shiyou!
original_name: ごっくんママを教育しよう!
source:
While cleaning up her son's room one day, a mother finds porno magazines and semen-covered tissues. She then searches through the tissues thrown away everyday into the wastebasket in his room, finding semen and licking it all up.

A short story featuring 7 different multi endings.
Female perverted ness, slave mama, queen mama, scat mama...
We'll introduce you to any mama that you fancy.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039542.html]DLsite English[/url]]
